item.title: Our Opinion: Keep questions coming in data center hearings
item.description: At a town-hall meeting he organized, to speak about an issue that has been boiling over throughout Northeast Pennsylvania over the last year, Republican state Rep. Jamie Walsh got to the heart of the matter when it came to the fears and concerns of a data center boom hitting our region.

item.title: State gaming board reports revenue increase; area casinos see decline
item.description: Combined statewide gaming revenue of $590.6 million represents an 11.6% increase over revenue reported in January 2025.

item.title: NE REGIONAL WRESTLING: Schuman, Caines capture Class 2A crowns
item.description: Honesdale’s Nathan Schuman and Hanover Area’s CJ Caines can define their seasons with one word — domination. Saturday proved no different. item.title: Wilkes-Barre Academy students celebrate their school
item.description: Wilkes-Barre Academy students recently participated in “Thinking Cap Day” as part of a School Choice Week celebration. The students enjoyed wearing their “thinking caps” throughout the day and partaking in a school-wide writing competition about what it means to be a Wilkes-Barre Academy student. Through the program, they were given the opportunity to express their thoughts and show why they choose to be a part of Wilkes-Barre Academy.
